hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We must split nums of length n into two equal arrays of length n / 2, each containing distinct elements.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: An array cannot contain distinct elements if any value appears more than once in it.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Therefore, no element can appear more than 2 times in the entire input nums.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency map check ensuring count <= 2 for all elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize pigeonhole principle: at most 2 copies can be placed in 2 distinct arrays.
